pairs: Exaudiat te Dominus in die tribulationis;
May the Lord hear you in the day of tribulation.
May the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
May he send you help from the sanctuary
and watch over you from Zion.
May he be mindful of all your sacrifices,
and may your burnt-offerings be fat.
May he grant to you according to your heart,
We will rejoice in your salvation,
et in nomine Dei nostri magnificabimur.
and in the name of our God, we will be magnified.
May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.
nunc cognovi quoniam salvum fecit Dominus christum suum.
Now I know that the Lord has saved his Christ.
Exaudiet illum de cælo sancto suo,
He will hear him from his holy heaven.
The salvation of his right hand is in his power.
nos autem in nomine Domini Dei nostri invocabimus.
but we will call upon the name of the Lord our God.
and we have been set upright.
et exaudi nos in die qua invocaverimus te.
and hear us on the day that we will call upon you.
